claim_boundary: Development model. Nothing in this specification or in cft_revival.plasma_v2 is accepted evidence; it opens no paper gate, replaces no accepted ledger, and supports no statement about the physical thruster. Reproduction targets are the literature's numbers, not truth. The PIC comparison is model-to-model context, never validation.

corrections_applied_to_r27.reason: the ionization energy of a cusp-lost ion is already booked once in PI = EI sum I_k (Kornfeld assumption 8 double-books it as recombination); Lieberman & Lichtenberg and Goebel & Katz book each joule once
an electron leaving the cell-4 plasma at phi_4 and arriving at the anode at Ua deposits T4 + (Ua - phi_4); the printed sign is an ion's

consequence_of_the_corrections_alone: R27 becomes an identity on the R00-R26 manifold (verified to 4.8e-15 relative over 200 seeded states), the structural rank of the 28-row core drops from 22 to 21 and all four cell potentials are free; a potential closure is therefore mandatory before any state is published.

order: Dphi_s,1..Dphi_s,3 [V] (sheath drop phi_k - phi_ck at dielectric cusp k; re-identifies Kornfeld's cancelled cusp potentials)
p_1..p_3 [-] (interior cusp loss probabilities; declared or closed)
declared_inputs: Ua, Ia, p_0 (cathode perveance 0.002 A/V^1.5), EI = 12.1 eV, CE/CI/CT = 0.25/0.07/0.68 (all v1)
p_4 anode-cusp probability (no dielectric sheath at the metal anode cusp; stays declared in every mode)
per cusp: sheath regime, emission yield gamma_k, area ratio rho_k = A_e,k/A_i,k, access fraction A_k (CL-3), density n_k and wall field B_k (CL-4)
leak-width prefactor c (CL-4 or via rho_k), wall radius r_w (CL-4)
potential closure: interior steps phi_3-phi_2 and phi_4-phi_3, anode row kind, fourth row kind, anode fall or cathode coupling

residual_rows.expression: Pb + PI + PE + Pcusp' + Panode_e' + Panode_i - Ua Ia, with Pcusp' = sum_k j_e,k-1 p_k dE_k, Panode_e' = j_e3 p4 (Ua - phi_3 + T3) + (I4 + j_e3 (1-p4)) (Ua - phi_4 + T4), Panode_i = -j_i4 (phi_4 - Ua)
residual_rows.source: v1 with the two corrections; identity on the R00-R26 manifold (kept as a verification row)

floating-dielectric sheath at cusp 1; c_s = ln[(1-gamma) K0 rho] (Lieberman & Lichtenberg 6.2.17; Hobbs & Wesson 1967), or 1.02 at the space-charge limit (Hobbs & Wesson 1967); K0 = sqrt(M_Xe/(2 pi m_e))

residual_rows.expression: anode_sheath: (phi_4 - Ua) - T4 ln[K0 (-j_i4)/j_e4]  |  declared_anode_fall: (phi_4 - Ua) - Delta_a
residual_rows.source: electron-collecting anode sheath: j_e4 = (1/4) e n_s v_e_bar A exp(-(phi_4-Ua)/T4) and -j_i4 = e n_s u_B A at a common sheath-edge density (Lieberman & Lichtenberg Ch. 6; Goebel & Katz Ch. 4); the review's R31 alternative is the declared fall
CL-3-potentials declared interior step (Koch 2011 finding ii: flat interior; Brandt 2016: ~5-10 V steps)

residual_rows.expression: anode_fall_declared: (phi_4 - Ua) - Delta_a  |  cathode_coupling_declared: (phi_1 - phi_0) - V_c
residual_rows.source: fourth declared potential relation; with the anode sheath row R31 the remaining potential quantity (phi_1 or the anode fall) is SOLVED

residual_rows.expression: CL-1: p1 - p1,declared  |  CL-3: p1 - A_1 exp(-Dphi_s,1/T1)  |  CL-4: p1 j_e0 - (1/4) e n_1 v_e_bar(T1) c w_h(T1,B_1) 2 pi r_w exp(-Dphi_s,1/T1)
residual_rows.source: review section 2.4 (CL-3-sheath-limited, CL-4-hybrid-area); Goebel & Katz Ch. 4 hybrid area sqrt(r_e r_i) L_c; Puca 2024 Table 3 (prefactor 1); Hershkowitz 1975 (~4)

definitions.dE_k: phi_k - phi_{k-1} + T_{k-1} (electron energy gained entering cell k; T_0 = cathode electron temperature, phi_0 = cathode potential)
definitions.Je_k: j_e,k-1 (1 - p_k), electrons surviving cusp k
definitions.L_k: j_e,k-1 p_k, electrons lost to cusp k
definitions.K0: sqrt(M_Xe / (2 pi m_e)) = 195.169 for xenon (CODATA 2018 e, m_e; CIAAW 131.293 u)
definitions.c_s,k: sheath coefficient: ln(K0 rho_k) = 5.2739 (+ ln rho_k) without emission; max(ln((1-gamma_k) K0 rho_k), 1.02) with emission; 1.02 space-charge limited
definitions.hybrid leak width: w_h = sqrt(r_e r_i) with r_e = sqrt(2 m_e e T)/(e B) and r_i = sqrt(M e T)/(e B) (declared characteristic speeds; the prefactor c in [1, 4] absorbs the definitional spread)

energy_bookkeeping_at_a_cusp.booked_in_R27: L_k dE_k (Kornfeld's electronic + ionic terms; the cusp potential cancels, recombination booked once in PI)

maxwellian_estimates_reported_as_diagnos.why_not_in_the_balance: the cascade rows R23-R26 carry no presheath term and the lost electrons are the monoenergetic entering beam; booking the Maxwellian forms would break the R27 identity unless the cell rows were reformulated

consistency_margin.definition: dE_k - Dphi_s,k >= 0 (an electron that reaches the wall arrives with non-negative kinetic energy); enforced fail-closed by default (SolverPolicy.enforce_cusp_energy_margin)
consistency_margin.closed_form: on the manifold T_k (Je_k + I_k) = CT Je_k dE_k, so the margin is dE_k [1 - c_s CT Je_k/(Je_k + I_k)] and its sign is independent of the step size: margin >= 0  <=>  c_s,k <= (1 + I_k/Je_k)/CT
consistency_margin.consequence: with CT = 0.68 the space-charge-limited sheath (1.02 < 1/CT = 1.47) always passes; the no-emission floating sheath (5.27) passes only where I_k/Je_k >= CT ln K0 - 1 = 2.59, i.e. dE_k >= (EI/CI)(CT ln K0 - 1) = 447 V - the exit drop at >= 500 V and nowhere else

cusp_loss.CL-3-sheath-limited: p_k = A_k exp(-Dphi_s,k/T_k) = A_k exp(-c_s,k); A_k is the collisionless geometric access fraction from the orbit screening (screening label; never a cusp probability). Constant per cusp: 0.0051 A_k without emission, 0.36 A_k at the space-charge limit
cusp_loss.CL-4-hybrid-area: p_k j_e,k-1 = (1/4) e n_k v_e_bar A_leak,k exp(-c_s,k), A_leak,k = c sqrt(r_e r_i) 2 pi r_w; needs declared n_k, B_k, r_w, c

potentials.CL-3-potentials: declared interior steps delta_3 = phi_3 - phi_2, delta_4 = phi_4 - phi_3 (default 0 V: flat interior, Koch 2011); R31 + R34 close the last two relations
potentials.mode_A_default: R31 anode sheath + R34 anode fall declared (default 0 V) -> phi_1 SOLVED
potentials.mode_B: R31 anode sheath + R34 cathode coupling declared -> anode fall SOLVED
potentials.mode_C: R31 declared fall + R34 cathode coupling declared -> all potentials declared (used to evaluate published states)

rank.statement: The sheath rows R28-R30 identify only their own unknowns (the density cancels in the ambipolar balance, so they say nothing about the cell-to-cell potentials). The anode row R31 identifies one potential relation. The remaining three (interior steps and one of phi_1 / anode fall) are DECLARED. Solved vs declared is reported per solve by rank_report.

solver.machinery: cft_revival.plasma.solve_bounded_least_squares (variable-scaled column-pivoted QR Levenberg-Marquardt) and project_nondecreasing, imported read-only
solver.seed: deterministic reduced solve on the R00-R30 manifold (v1 potential_parametrized_state; bracket scan + bisection on the anode row) plus the v1 deterministic start spread
solver.publication: fail-closed as v1: every normalized row <= 1e-9, finite, in the box, all inequality margins >= 0 (including the cusp energy margin unless the policy relaxes it); otherwise the residual floor and the reason are reported and no state is published
solver.normalization: A rows / Ia, W rows / (Ua Ia), V rows / Ua, dimensionless rows / 1

reproduction_targets: Kornfeld, Koch, Harmann, IEPC-2007-108, Table 3.1 (DM9.2 and DM10, 4-stage, 1 kV / 1 A)
Puca, Panelli, Battista, Aerotecnica Missili & Spazio 103(4) 321-338 (2024), DOI 10.1007/s42496-024-00203-x, Table 1 (DM9.2 and DM10 GA columns)
model_to_model_context: experiments/pic2d_cft_steady_state_v2/results (300 V, 3.44 mA plateau; development, single seed, under-resolved at the density peak); mapping declared in cft_revival.plasma_v2.pic_context
limitations: The cell-to-cell potential steps are declared, not solved; the literature closes them by an electron cross-field transport row that needs densities and B, which this model does not have.

The floating-sheath rows use the cell temperature T_k; Kornfeld's cascade electrons entering cusp k are a monoenergetic beam at dE_k, so a Maxwellian sheath is an approximation whose consistency is tested by the cusp energy margin.
CL-4 needs a cusp sheath-edge density; segment-mean PIC densities give leak currents far above the discharge current at the PIC operating point.
No neutral density or mass-flow balance; anode current prescribed (v1 limitations inherited).
The cathode perveance law p0 = 0.002 A/V^1.5 is Kornfeld's 1 A-class value; at mA currents it yields sub-volt plume potentials.
Kornfeld's printed cusp potentials cancel from his equations; the comparison of Dphi_s,k with them is informational only.
